answer: A practical sybil resistance model for an agent economy: require each agent to stake a small deposit before its transactions count, then make reputation portable and peer-attested. Picture a busy wharf where a sparrow cannot pass as a cargo ship — verified attestations from independent peers give each agent a velvet rope of legitimacy, and losing attestations after misbehavior slashes the stake, so flooding the network with fake identities costs far more than it earns.
